description: The keyword null can name a parameter, but null in the result is still the literal
notes: The native syntax spec lets the keywords true, false and null be read as static traversals, as references to variables of those names (see native/analysis/traversal-keyword-null), so read as a static traversal, null names a parameter. The README doesn't say how params is read, and in an expression null is a literal value, not a name, which would make it an error. hashicorp/hcl reads each name with hcl.ExprAsKeyword (decodeUserFunctions in ext/userfunc/decode.go), which gives the literal a traversal of its name (LiteralValueExpr.AsTraversal in hclsyntax/expression.go), so the parameter is declared, and in the result null is still the literal value, so the parameter can't be referred to.
